trade_logic.preferred_trigger: Hold/retest above 77.34k dPOC for 5-15 minutes with no fresh price breakdown; stronger if CVD stabilizes and OI stops accelerating.
trade_logic.starter_size_guidance: Only small starter exposure until retest confirms; do not chase a single reclaim candle.

lesson: Flow divergence becomes actionable only when price structure confirms it. This snapshot is materially better than prior CVD/OI-only long candidates because dPOC has actually been reclaimed.
